SuperLinkPRO Windows includes the separate dfu-util program, libusb and the MinGW-w64 winpthreads runtime.
The included COPYING files give the licenses and notices. The binaries are copied unmodified from the exact MSYS2 packages in manifest.json.
Corresponding source for dfu-util and libusb, including MSYS2 packaging recipes: https://minichao9901.github.io/superlinkPRO/third-party/dfu-util-0.11-msys2-sources.zip
The Windows workbench Release also includes dfu-util-0.11-msys2-sources.zip.
